name: diag_flip_partial_fp203_r01
command:
import json,math,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import merge_pair_v2 as merge
from src.tools import t01v2_live_progress as live
from src.tools import t01v2_look_funnel as funnel
from src.tools.t01v2_flip_review_checkpoint import source_support
from src.envs import pair_v2_flip_policy as policy
from src.envs import pair_v2_fixed_labels as labels
from src.envs.pair_v2_flip_search import AttemptQuota
report_name=sys.argv[1]
if re.fullmatch(r"diag_[A-Za-z0-9_]+",report_name) is None: raise ValueError("Require unique diag_ report name")
directory=merge.ROOT/"logs/runs"/report_name/"evidence"
directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
observed=[]; seen_sources=set()
with source_support():
 for argument in sys.argv[2:]:
  path=(merge.ROOT/argument).resolve()
  if path in seen_sources: raise ValueError("Duplicate explicit source")
  seen_sources.add(path)
  data,reference=merge.load_source(path)
  cfg,meta,metrics=data["config"],data["_meta"],data["metrics"]
  policy.validate_source(cfg,metrics)
  if (not meta.get("end") or type(meta.get("exit_code")) is not int or meta["exit_code"]==0
      or not metrics.get("terminal_finalization_error") or metrics.get("attempts") is not None):
   raise ValueError("This diagnostic is only for an ended failed source without a sealed terminal journal")
  expected=live.expected_identity(path.stem); live.check_expected_shard(expected,cfg["shard"])
  if cfg["name"]!=expected["name"] or cfg["scene"]!=expected["scene"]: raise ValueError("Source identity differs")
  arguments=merge.producer_arguments(meta["command"],policy.PRODUCER)
  if merge.option(arguments,"--name")!=cfg["name"] or merge.option(arguments,"--scene")!=cfg["scene"]:
   raise ValueError("Source command identity differs")
  journal=merge.ROOT/"data/world_pairs/v2"/(cfg["name"]+"_attempts.jsonl")
  if cfg["attempt_journal"]!=str(journal.relative_to(merge.ROOT)): raise ValueError("Unexpected source journal")
  raw,extent=live.read_prefix(journal)
  if extent["read_cap_reached"]: raise ValueError("Complete ended journal exceeds the existing prefix cap")
  archived=live.archive(raw,directory,cfg["name"]+"_journal.prefix")
  counts=live.observed_counts(raw,cfg["scene"])
  rows=[]; times=[]; quota=AttemptQuota()
  for line in raw.decode("utf-8").splitlines():
   if not line.strip(): continue
   item=json.loads(line)
   raw_path=merge.reference_path(item["raw_attempt"],within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
   if raw_path.name!="attempt.json" or re.fullmatch(re.escape(item["pair_id"])+r"_trial[0-9]{6}",raw_path.parent.name) is None:
    raise ValueError("Raw attempt path differs from its explicit pair identity")
   attempt=merge.read_reference(item["raw_attempt"],within=cfg["raw_evidence_dir"])
   if any(attempt.get(key)!=item.get(key) for key in ("pair_id","scene","kind","status","discard_reasons","generation_seconds","pair_file","pair_sha256")):
    raise ValueError("Archived journal differs from authenticated raw attempt")
   if attempt.get("counts_as_pair_attempt") is not True or attempt.get("proposed_pool",item.get("proposed_pool"))!="look":
    raise ValueError("Journal does not name an actual counted Look attempt")
   labels.validate_fields(attempt)
   quota.record(raw_path,attempt)
   for world in ("w0","w1"):
    declared=item.get(world+"_valid_physical")
    actual=(attempt.get("physical_"+world) or (attempt.get("physical_key_numbers") or {}).get("physical_"+world) or {}).get("valid_physical")
    if type(declared) is bool and declared is not actual: raise ValueError("Journal/raw physical result differs")
   duration=attempt.get("generation_seconds")
   if type(duration) not in (int,float) or not math.isfinite(duration) or duration<0: raise ValueError("Missing measured attempt timer")
   times.append(duration)
   rows.append({**attempt,"anchor_type":item.get("anchor_type"),"source_file":reference["file"],"raw_attempt":item["raw_attempt"]})
  total=meta.get("duration_sec")
  recorded=sum(times)
  residual=total-recorded if type(total) in (int,float) and math.isfinite(total) else None
  observed.append({"source":reference,"scene":cfg["scene"],"field_of_view":cfg["field_of_view"],
   "source_exit_code":meta["exit_code"],"source_status":metrics.get("status"),
   "terminal_finalization_error":metrics["terminal_finalization_error"],
   "journal_observed_prefix":{**extent,"snapshot":archived},"observed_prefix_counts":counts,
   "observed_prefix_actual_quota":quota.summary(),
   "groups":[{"mode":mode,"funnel":funnel.summarize([row for row in rows if row["mode"]==mode])} for mode in ("flip","stay")],
   "by_anchor":[{"anchor_type":anchor,"mode":mode,"funnel":funnel.summarize([row for row in rows if row["anchor_type"]==anchor and row["mode"]==mode])}
    for anchor in sorted({row["anchor_type"] for row in rows},key=lambda value:"" if value is None else value) for mode in ("flip","stay")],
   "timing":{"logged_total_duration_sec":total,"observed_counted_generation_seconds_sum":recorded,
    "outside_observed_counted_spans_seconds":residual,"discovery_seconds":None,
    "scope":"Residual includes uncounted placements, startup/preflight/discovery/serialization/finalization/cleanup; not attributed to discovery"},
   "sealed_final":False,"independent_acceptance_passed":False,
   "scope":"Authenticated observed journal prefix of failed unsealed source; diagnostics only. No final total and no independently accepted pair can be claimed."})
print("PARTIAL_ENDED_FLIP_FUNNEL_JSON: "+json.dumps({"sources":observed,"archive_directory":str(directory.relative_to(merge.ROOT)),
 "source_mutations":False,"thresholds_changed":False,"independent_acceptance_possible":False,
 "unreached_gate_measurements":"unknown, preserved by existing funnel.summarize"},sort_keys=True,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
